subject: GCP private offer: tiered redemption schedule and invoice alignment
messages:
From: Anika Desai <anika.desai@cloudbridge.com>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudbridge.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: GCP private offer - proposed tiered redemption schedule (Cloudbridge)

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Following up with the draft private offer and a proposed redemption cadence that helps Cloudbridge align commit drawdown with projected production ramp. Key asks from our side:

- Can Redwood support a two-tier redemption schedule (stair-step) so we can avoid big front-loaded charges?
- We need invoice milestones that line up with monthly usage reporting and a single consolidated monthly invoice (Net 30).
- Would you accept a 30% initial tranche, then 10% monthly for months 2–10, with a final true-up month?

I've attached the draft offer and our PO template for your procurement. If you have alternative phasing suggestions that reduce runway risk for Cloudbridge, happy to discuss.

Attachments: CB_private_offer_draft_v1.pdf (private offer draft, 12 pages), CB_PO_template.xlsx

Regards,
Anika Desai
Partner Lead — GCP Marketplace
Cloudbridge Inc
anika.desai@cloudbridge.com
+1 (650) 555-0143
From: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
To: Anika Desai <anika.desai@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer - proposed tiered redemption schedule (Cloudbridge)

Hi Anika — thanks for the draft and the tranche proposal. Looping in Marissa (Marketplace partnerships) and Ben (Finance) to align controls. Quick thoughts from the Redwood side: 

- We can support a stair-step redemption, but we prefer a slightly different shape to balance cash flow and capacity commitments. Proposed alternative: 25% initial, 8% monthly months 2–11, 7% final true-up (keeps total predictable and smooths monthly recognition).
- For billing: we can emit consolidated monthly invoices to Cloudbridge with Net 30. Ben, can you confirm Redwood's required invoice-trigger artifacts (GL codes, PO # placement, remittance address)?
- Contractually, we'll need the private offer updated to reflect the altered redemption schedule and a revised offer ID before we accept. Also request: include a clause that allows a single 60-day grace buffer for tranche redemption in case of delayed onboarding.

If Cloudbridge is open to the 25/8/7 shape I'll ask Marissa to update the marketplace offer record and then we can route the DocuSign with the updated offer.

Thanks,
Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Lukas / Anika — quick finance note:

- Redwood can do consolidated monthly invoices (Net 30). We require PO# on the invoice and the PO must reference the private offer ID once it's finalized.
- For accounting, please include the following on the PO: Redwood legal entity (Redwood Inference, Inc), Redwood tax ID, and GL code mapping (we'll send our GL mapping spreadsheet if helpful).
- We'll need Cloudbridge's billing contact and remittance address; attach Redwood's W9 for your AP. Attaching Redwood_W9.pdf for your AP team.

Anika, if you can provide a slightly updated PO (CB_PO_template.xlsx) with the 25/8/7 schedule and a tentative start date, we can prerecord the AR schedule and avoid surprises in month 1.

Thanks — Ben
